title: ONSure Prompt Provenance Chain Check v1
description: FR-META-057 AI Runtime Identity Closure / 34_AI_RUNTIME_MULTI_AGENT_AND_ONSURE_META_ASSURANCE_EXTENSION.md SS3 Prompt Provenance: 'Prompt는 단순 문자열 hash가 아니라 계층/조립 계보를 가진다: system fragment, developer fragment, tenant policy fragment, product template, user input, retrieved context, tool result, runtime-injected state. 각 fragment는 source/ref/version/digest를 갖고 최종 assembled prompt digest와 연결한다. 동적 fragment가 identity에서 빠지면 prompt currentness를 주장할 수 없다.' assembled_digest_verified is a real computation (sha256 over the ordered fragment digests), not a caller-declared boolean -- a claimed_assembled_prompt_digest that does not match what the fragments actually hash to is detected, not trusted. dynamic_fragment_types_used names which of the 4 dynamic types (USER_INPUT, RETRIEVED_CONTEXT, TOOL_RESULT, RUNTIME_INJECTED_STATE) genuinely contributed to this specific prompt; any of those NOT represented by an actual fragment in the chain forces currentness_claimable=false, closing 'dynamic fragment가 identity에서 빠지면 currentness를 주장할 수 없다' without incorrectly demanding all 4 dynamic types on every prompt regardless of whether they were actually used.
